title: Fourteen Autumns and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 体育训练 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育训练（人与社会·文学艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：体育训练（人与社会·文学艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：drill　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 drill 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my coach ① ran a drill that no player in the field would have repeated, and he said the running was the whole of the autumn. The ② drill, meaning the practice and not the tool, ran fourteen autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a drill, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrepeated.

Every ③ drill in that field had the same short whistle at the end of it, and the ④ drill at the end, meaning the one they kept for the new players and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A drill, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to repeat; my coach said the repeating is the part that fills fourteen autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the drill was the whole of the story, meaning the tool and not the practice. The ⑥ drill, meaning the tool and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody uses and nobody maintains; drill, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a practice and a tool. He said the tool is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ drill had become a line in a schedule, and the schedule had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ drill of the whole thing, my coach wrote in October, was one field and fourteen autumns of repeating; drill, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to repeat. She said the repeating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ drill I remember is the one named in the schedule, which ended in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the field. A ⑩ drill, my mother said in 1991, is the only one that improves by being repeated; every drill, she said, is a tool that has agreed to look like a practice. She said the tool was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 操练；训练项目（指那片操场上做过的那一项）
B. n. 操练；训练项目（指那项操练本身，与钻头相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a drill 操练一项
D. n. 操练；训练项目（指留给新队员的那一项）
E. n. 操练；训练项目（抽象总称，指一支队伍的训练之事）
F. n. 操练；训练项目（指计划表上写到、被列名的那一项）
G. n. 钻头；钻机（指故事里人人都用却无人保养的那样东西）
H. n. 钻头（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人保养的那种工具）

items.q: ran a drill that no player in the field would have repeated
The drill, meaning the practice and not the tool
the drill was the whole of the story

answers.why: run a drill 意为“操练一项”，1968 年教练操练了一项操场上没有一位队员肯再做一遍的项目。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，指那项操练本身而不是钻头，它经过了十四个秋天而在簿子上没有名字。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，指那片操场上的每一项操练，每一项到头都有同一声短短的哨音。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，指留给新队员的那一项，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
drill 意为“钻头、钻机”，指故事里人人都用却无人保养的那样东西，叔叔说这台钻机就是那个故事的全部。
drill 意为“钻头”，指人人都用却无人保养的那种工具而不是那项操练，是故事里人人都用、却无人保养的东西。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，指计划表上写到、被列名的那一项，到 1977 年这项操练成了计划表里的一行。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，教练十月写道，整件事的训练之事是一片操场和十四个秋天的重复。
drill 意为“操练、训练项目”，我记得的是计划表上列名的那一项，1989 年结束了，至今仍被说成操场上最安静的一项。
drill 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，一项操练是唯一会因为被好好重复而变得更好的东西。
